office: Representative, Maguindanao del Sur Lone District
role: District Representative · Maguindanao del Sur, Lone District
profileLabel: Conservative-leaning social values and restrictive civil liberties (low confidence)
summary: Maguindanao del Sur representative with 24 principal-authored bills. Authored mandatory prayer rooms in public and private spaces, mandatory pre-marriage orientation for Muslims, an NCMF act amendment and the date of the first Bangsamoro parliamentary elections. Co-authored espionage law expansion, disinformation penalties, an anti-dynasty ban, a postponement of barangay and SK elections and the national minimum wage.
caveat: Pre-marriage orientation is a religious-accommodation measure under Muslim personal law and may not signal conservatism toward the wider population. Civil liberties rests on co-authored bills only.

economic.label: Insufficient evidence
economic.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

social.rationale: Authored mandatory prayer rooms in public and private spaces (-2) and mandatory pre-marriage orientation and counseling for Muslims (-2). Religious accommodation measures; two issues.

civil.label: Restrictive-leaning
